credits_spent: free plan; one generation, published on the Mixo subdomain
failures: P3: No series pages. The gallery page holds 23 photographs and a navigation with only 'Homepage' and 'Gallery'; there is no link to Harbour Light, Interiors or Quiet Portraits.

P4: No biography. The home page offers one sentence of positioning ('Explore thoughtful photography ... from luminous harbour scenes to quiet, intimate portraits') and the contact form, but no about text.
P7: Images are 800x650 CDN crops, none is wrapped in a link and no viewer opens on click.
P15: Lighthouse mobile performance 88 (LCP 3.6 s), below the threshold of 90.
notes: Mixo built the site from one description in about two minutes, then asked for an account and a domain. The free path is 'Continue with Mixo subdomain'; the offered custom domain costs 30 $/year. The result is a two-page site (home and /gallery) with 23 photographs and a working contact form, all images with alt text, but no series pages and no about section. The stored page title on the live home reads 'Contact Still Point Studio | Photography Enquiries' although the page shows the portfolio.
